title: Signature invariants of monomial ideals
summary: Let $I$ be a monomial ideal of a polynomial ring $R=K[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ over a field $K$ and let ${\rm sgn}(I)$ be its signature ideal. If $I$ is not a principal ideal, we show that the depth of $R/I$ is the depth of $R/{\rm sgn}(I)$, and the regularity of $R/{\rm sgn}(I)$ is at most the regularity of $R/I$. For ideals of height at least $2$, we show that the associated primes of $I$ and ${\rm sgn}(I)$ are the same, and we show that $I$ is Cohen--Macaulay (resp.
